verses.text: <pb/><e>Ekpere Devid.</e> <pb/><t>Jehova, tọ nti-Gi n'ala, zam;</t> <t>N'ihi na onye ewedara n'ala na ob͕eye ka m'bu.</t>
<t>Debe nkpuru-obim; n'ihi na onye-ebere ka m'bu:</t> <t>Gi onwe-gi Chinekem, zọputa orù-Gi nke nātukwasi obi na Gi.</t>
<t>Merem amara, Onye-nwe-ayi;</t> <t>N'ihi na Gi ka m'nākpọku ogologo ubọchi nile.</t>
<t>Me ka nkpuru-obi orù-Gi ṅuria;</t> <t>N'ihi na ọ bu Gi, Onye-nwe-ayi, ka m'nēbuli nkpuru-obim nye.</t>
<t>N'ihi na Gi onwe-gi, Onye-nwe-ayi, di nma, I bu kwa onye nāb͕aghara nmehie,</t> <t>I nāba kwa uba n'ebere n'aru ndì nile nākpọku Gi.</t>
<t>Jehova, ge nti n'ekperem;</t> <t>Ṅa kwa nti n'olu arirọ-amaram nile.</t>
<t>N'ubọchi nkpàm m'gākpọku Gi;</t> <t>N'ihi na I gāzam.</t>
<t>Ọ dighi onye di ka Gi n'etiti chi nile, Onye-nwe-ayi;</t> <t>Ọ dighi kwa ọlu di ka ọlu-Gi nile.</t>
<t>Mba nile ndi I meworo gābia kpọ isí ala n'iru Gi, Onye-nwe-ayi;</t> <t>Ha gāsọpuru kwa aha-Gi.</t>
<t>N'ihi na onye uku ka I bu, I nālu kwa oké ọlu di iche iche:</t> <t>Gi onwe-gi bu Chineke, nání Gi.</t>
<t>Zim uzọ-Gi Jehova; m'gējeghari n'ezi-okwu-Gi:</t> <t>Me ka obim di n'otù itu egwu aha-Gi.</t>
<t>M'gēji obim nile kele Gi, Onye-nwe-ayi, Chineke;</t> <t>M'gāsọpuru kwa aha-Gi rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi.</t>
<t>N'ihi na ebere-Gi di uku n'arum;</t> <t>I siwo n'ala-mọ nke dichasi ala naputa nkpuru-obim.</t>
<t>Chineke, ndi-nganga ebiliwo imegidem,</t> <t>Nzukọ ndi nēme ka madu ma jijiji achọwo kwa nkpuru-obim,</t> <t>Ha edoghi kwa Gi n'iru ha.</t>
<t>Ma Gi onwe-gi, Onye-nwe-ayi, bu Chineke Nke nwere obi-ebere, Onye di kwa amara,</t> <t>Nke nādighi-ewe iwe ọsọsọ, Nke nāba kwa uba n'ebere na ezi-okwu.</t>
<t>Chem iru, me-kwa-ram amara</t> <t>Nye orù-Gi ike-Gi,</t> <t>Zọputa kwa nwa-nwoke nke orù-Gi nwayi.</t>
<t>Merem ihe-iriba-ama bayere ezi ihe I gēmerem;</t> <t>Ka ndi nākpọm asì we hu ya, ka ihere we me ha,</t> <t>N'ihi na Gi onwe-gi, Jehova, eyeworom aka, kasikwam obi.</t>
